data.title: Tropical Depression Fay (AT1), advisory 26/2037Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY SLOWLY MOVING SOUTHWARD. As of 9:00 PM GMT Sat Sep 26 the center of Fay was located near 29.8, -43.9 with movement S at 2 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1009 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Post-Tropical Cyclone Gonzalo (AT2), advisory 26/2037Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: GONZALO NO LONGER A TROPICAL CYCLONE. ...THIS IS THE FINAL ADVISORY... As of 8:00 PM CVT Sat Sep 26 the center of Gonzalo was located near 19.3, -23.3 with movement NNW at 7 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1005 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 40 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Odalys (EP1), advisory 26/2033Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: ODALYS CONTINUES TO QUICKLY WEAKEN. As of 2:00 PM PDT Sat Sep 26 the center of Odalys was located near 20.5, -123.6 with movement N at 7 mph. The minimum central pressure was 973 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 90 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 26/2357Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: NOAA HURRICANE HUNTER AIRCRAFT ABOUT TO INVESTIGATE POLO. ...THE HURRICANE IS FORECAST TO APPROACH BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR ON MONDAY... As of 5:00 PM MST Sat Sep 26 the center of Polo was located near 19.1, -112.8 with movement NW at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 940 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 140 mph.
